title: Samudragupta’s Expeditions
subject: History
caption: Map of Samudragupta’s expeditions across the Indian subcontinent.
altText: A textbook-quality map on a white background showing the routes of Samudragupta’s military campaigns. Colored arrows indicate his southern expedition into the Deccan, his eastern advance into Kalinga, his north‑west push into the Punjab region, and other raids. Major ancient Indian kingdoms such as Kalinga, Andhra, Dravida, Malava, and Gandhara are clearly labelled, along with key cities like Pataliputra, Prayaga, Ujjain, and Mathura. Rivers and mountain ranges are also marked, and a legend explains the arrow colors. The illustration is high resolution, accurate to historical sources, and designed for educational use.
